# SeaBIOS firmware artifact

This directory vendors the SeaBIOS runtime firmware used by ASL's
`seabios-x86_64` boot profile.

- Source package: SeaBIOS
- Packaged source on the development host: Debian `seabios` 1.16.3-2
- Runtime artifact: `seabios.bin`
- Installed anyOS path: `/System/var/asl/firmware/seabios.bin`
- SHA-256: `1a9ea4f17bcfb27bda5728e2c21d9fa074cf7947b9b4910bb28213a735c96735`

The bundled copyright and license summary from the Debian package is kept in
`COPYRIGHT.debian`.
